name: sanitize_instead_of_reject
description: Misreads the task as 'sanitize' rather than 'reject': strips null bytes, normalizes backslashes to slashes, and returns only the basename instead of raising ValueError. So 'a/b', '../etc/passwd', and 'x\x00y' are silently rewritten and returned rather than rejected, violating the required raise-on-unsafe-input contract.
